QuestInfo.name: Who Watches the Watchmen?
QuestInfo.0: It's time to disembark from the #m150000000# and investigate the Black Wings in #m310000000#. Don't forget the hat that #p1401001# gave you...
QuestInfo.1:
#m310000000# had three Black Wings watchmen: Watchman #p2152017#, Watchman #p2152018#, and Watchman #p2152016#. Watchman #p2152016# is the highest ranking member, #p2152017# the lowest. #bInvestigate from the lowest rank up#k. #bPut on the Black Wings Hat first#k.

QuestInfo.2: Your investigation revealed that the watchmen don't actually do anything in #m310000000#, they just keep an eye out. You'll have to look elsewhere to find the big fish.

0.0: This place is alright. Clean, well-maintained... a little too nice.
0.1: There are three watchmen in total: #p2152017#, #p2152018#, and #p2152016#. #p2152016# is in charge and #p2152017# is the lowest on the totem pole. It will be easier to start with #bthe lowest ranking watchman first#k.
0.2: Time to put on my infiltrating hat...

yes.0: #b#p2152017##k first. She looked like a real pushover. I believe I saw her by the lower western side of the town.

no.0: Actually, I should take a look around first. This place IS pretty nice and I get the feeling they sell excellent clocks.

1.0: First up, #p2152017#. Her duty - analyzing #o1150000# recordings. Looking over her dossier, it doesn't look like she gives it her all. In summary, lazy as can be.
1.1: Second, #p2152018#. His duty - town regulation. He joined the Black Wings to save his lady friend, but ended up another Black Wings hostage. In summary, might be talkative.
1.2: Third, #p2152016#. He's in charge of all the other watchmen. He sends full reports on all goings-on back to the top Black Wings. In summary, mildly dangerous.
1.3: It doesn't seem like any of them are even worth looking into at this point, but they might have information on the people above them.

yes.0: That #p2152016# character looked like he knew a little something. Maybe I should talk to him.
